toolchain_note: Restored ephemeral toolchain (jdk4py 25.0.2.1, ECJ 3.16.0 from npm coc-java@1.0.0, api jars and ProGuard from vipaoL/j2me-build-tools). Rebuilding Quantum_RiverMap_Pixel from unchanged sources is byte-identical for 209/210 entries; only the compiled RiverPixelPreview$Viewer differs: the original toolchain bound inherited getWidth/getHeight calls to the compile-time subclass (Viewer), while the restored ECJ binds them to the declaring supertype javax/microedition/lcdui/Displayable. Both references resolve identically on a real MIDP 2.0 device. This build therefore reuses the six published RiverPixel renderer/stats classes byte-for-byte instead of recompiling them, and no RiverPixelPreview classes are packaged.

diagnostic.purpose: Price nearest-neighbour upscale delivery (C) of a reduced viewport against the fill it saves (R). No handset FPS claim.
diagnostic.map: old sym9 village/river map from immutable Perspective/Tex3 parent: maps/kordos/kordos.3d, baked lightmap/kordod.vla, Tex3 slots forest/map-selo1/river
diagnostic.renderer: byte-identical published RiverPixelMesh/Stats classes; verifier compares jar entries against Quantum_RiverMap_Pixel

handset_model_prior.area_model: R ~= 30 ms fixed + ~74 ms x full-screen area, confirmed at S100/S75/S50/S25; S50 R48-51, S25 R32
handset_model_prior.fill_split_fullscreen: texture ~20 ms, smooth colour interpolation ~16 ms, depth+iterate+write ~42 ms
handset_model_prior.farm_pump_copy_baseline: full-screen Image drawImage copy was small (~1 ms) in FramePump; Java NN upscale expand cost unknown on E65

diagnostic.default: S100 DIR TEX SM B (full viewport, 1:1 delivery, atlas textures, smooth shading, base-level filtering)

controls.key1: BASE reset: S100 + DIR + TEX + SMOOTH + BASE_LEVEL
controls.key0: cycle render scale 100 -> 75 -> 50 -> 25 percent (other toggles preserved)
controls.key3: toggle delivery DIR <-> UP: black-bar 1:1 image copy vs nearest upscale to full screen
controls.key7: toggle atlas textures <-> 1x1 white texture (pixel diagnostic inheritance)
controls.star: toggle texture level filter BASE_LEVEL <-> NEAREST (nearest mip level; a hint, may be ignored)
controls.movement: 2/8 move, 4/6 turn; no strafe because 7/9 are pixel toggles

delivery.dir: native Image rendered at scaled viewport size, drawn 1:1 top-left; uncovered Canvas bars filled black outside native render timing (identical to river pixel diagnostic)
delivery.up: same offscreen native Image, then Image.getRGB + integer nearest-neighbour expand + Graphics.drawRGB false-alpha over the whole Canvas; at S100 UP intentionally degrades to the same 1:1 drawImage as DIR (pipeline control)
delivery.upscale_algorithm: dst(x,y)=src(floor(x*sw/dw), floor(y*sh/dh)); same-source rows reused via arraycopy; buffers allocated once per scale change, not per frame
delivery.hud: drawn after delivery so it is never upscaled; two live lines: mode/FPS and N/R/C/I where C is the measured delivery window getRGB+expand+draw (or DIR bar+copy)

diagnostic.m3g_compatibility: Target user-reported Nokia E65 M3G 1.0: renderer unchanged from the pixel diagnostic; upscale uses only MIDP 2.0 Graphics/Image entry points already exercised by the game
diagnostic.alpha: original thresholds in TEX modes, as parent
diagnostic.depth: test/write ON except river write OFF, as parent
diagnostic.river: all 4 cached frames, speed6, mode7, as parent
diagnostic.pump: same worker repaint()+serviceRepaints()+sleep(1) in all modes, as parent
diagnostic.stats_note: N/R/C/I are Java API wall time, NOT GPU timestamps or proven LCD flips; C is not free even when it reads 0.0 because lower timer resolution may hide sub-ms work

purpose: Isolated river-map upscale-delivery A/B: DIR black bars vs UP nearest full-screen expansion over the existing pixel-cost renderer.
